questions.text: Is climate action the core purpose or goal of the policy?
questions.answer: The policy clearly identifies climate action as a core purpose. The local government acknowledges climate change as a global issue requiring urgent and sustained effort. The policy outlines a proactive approach to developing and implementing strong climate change policy that is evidence-based and aligned with the best available science. The policy also outlines specific actions such as the development of a utility scale solar farm, the creation of a Zero-net Emissions (ZNE) Plan, and the Blue Heart project for carbon sequestration. The policy also aims for the council to be a net-zero emissions organization by 2041 and for the community to be low-carbon by 2041. These actions and goals demonstrate that climate action is a central purpose of the policy.
